name: wled
title: WLED Status Lights
author: bespoked
description: Connects a network-attached WLED LED strip to Moonraker's built-in [wled] support, so your printer can drive status lighting (and you can control it from Fluidd/Mainsail and from macros). Point it at your WLED device's address and set how many LEDs it has. WLED hardware is separate; this only configures Moonraker to talk to it.
tagline: Drive a WLED LED strip from your printer.

variables.name: WLED_ADDRESS
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the WLED device (e.g. wled.local or 192.168.1.50)

config.label: Strip name
config.hint: Name used in macros and the UI, e.g. WLED_ON STRIP=status.

config.label: WLED address
config.hint: Hostname or IP of your WLED device.

config.label: LED count
config.hint: Number of LEDs on the strip.

attributions:
# Attributions - wled

**Plugin author:** Bespok3d, driving Moonraker's built-in `[wled]` against WLED by Christian Schwinne (Aircoookie); WLED on the U1 was first done in the Extended Firmware overlay `12-patch-moonraker` (paxx12)

Controls WLED light strips from the printer.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WLED | Christian Schwinne (Aircoookie) and the WLED contributors | MIT | yes | no |

WLED runs on your own light controller; nothing from it ships inside this plugin, which only
configures Moonraker's built-in `[wled]` component. Upstream: https://github.com/Aircoookie/WLED

Ported from the Extended Firmware overlay `12-patch-moonraker` (paxx12), GPL-3.0.
